mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their thresholds, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL>3.5 and FEDFUNDS>0.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 450000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 140,000 thousand signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE>5.5 and PAYEMS<140000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 237.5 signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 237.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
